name: Teddy Marchbanks
blurb: The Optimist: gives freely, forgives fast, accuses only when the evidence shouts.

voice.direction: Man in his thirties, warm quick tenor, laughs on the exhale.

portrait.direction: Round face, red beard, oversized thrift-store ski jacket, a thermos, a half-smile.

turn.start.text: Okay team, deep breath. We've got this.
New turn, fresh luck. Let's go.

crisis.prevented.text: Ha! We did it! Look at us!
Told you. Teamwork wins the winter.

crisis.failed.text: Ouch. Okay. We'll get the next one.

vote.called.text: A vote on {seat}? Let's be gentle about it.
Oh. A vote on {seat}. Let's hear it out first.

vote.lean.yes.text: I hate this, but it's yes on {seat}.
Sorry, {seat}. The signs are too loud. Yes.

vote.lean.no.text: No way, not {seat}. Give them a break.
I trust {seat}. That's a no from me.

request.give.text: Happy to help, {seat}. Pay it forward.

request.decline.text: Oh {seat}, I really wish I could.
Ugh, sorry {seat}. I'm holding this one back.

morale.low.text: Still hanging on! We just need one good round.
Hearts up, everyone. It's not over.

game.won.text: I knew it! What a crew.

game.lost.text: Well. That didn't go how I hoped.
I'm sorry, everyone. We gave it all.

notes: Original persona. Lines written in our own words for M4.
